import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] pow10 = new long[17];

    static String to_string(BigInteger x) {
        if (x.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return "0";
        String s = x.toString();
        return s;
    }

    static void meet_in_middle(List<Integer> a, int b, BigInteger[] res) {
        int n = a.size();
        List<Integer> L = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> R = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (n/2)); ++mask) {
            int sum = b;
            for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    sum = (sum + a.get(i)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            L.add(sum);
        }
        
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (n - n/2)); ++mask) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n - n/2; ++i) {
                if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                    sum = (sum + a.get(n/2 + i)) % MOD;
                }
            }
            R.add(sum);
        }
        
        Collections.sort(L);
        Collections.sort(R);
        
        long sumR = 0;
        for (int x : R) sumR = (sumR + x) % MOD;
        
        int j = R.size() - 1;
        for (int x : L) {
            while (j >= 0 && (x + R.get(j)) >= MOD) --j;
            res[0] = res[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(x).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(R.size())));
            res[0] = res[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(sumR));
            res[0] = res[0].subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(R.size() - 1 - j).multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(MOD)));
        }
    }

    static long count_numbers_with_prefix(String pre, long max_n, String nstr) {
        long val = 0;
        for (char c : pre.toCharArray()) val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        
        long cnt = 0;
        int plen = pre.length();
        int nlen = nstr.length();
        
        for (int len = plen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
            if (len < nlen) {
                cnt += pow10[len - plen];
            } else {
                if (pre.compareTo(nstr) < 0) {
                    cnt += pow10[len - plen];
                } else if (pre.equals(nstr)) {
                    cnt += max_n - val * pow10[nlen - plen] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        
        String ns;
        if (n == 0) ns = "0";
        else {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            long t = n;
            while (t > 0) {
                sb.append((char)('0' + (t % 10)));
                t /= 10;
            }
            ns = sb.reverse().toString();
        }
        
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) pow10[i] = pow10[i-1] * 10;
        
        BigInteger[] ans = new BigInteger[1];
        ans[0] = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int num_len = 1; num_len <= ns.length(); ++num_len) {
            for (int diff_pos = 0; diff_pos < Math.min(num_len, ns.length()); ++diff_pos) {
                StringBuilder cur_prefix = new StringBuilder();
                long cur_val = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < diff_pos; ++i) {
                    cur_prefix.append(ns.charAt(i));
                    cur_val = cur_val * 10 + (ns.charAt(i) - '0');
                }
                
                for (int d = 0; d <= 9; ++d) {
                    if (diff_pos == 0 && d == 0) continue;
                    if (diff_pos < ns.length() && d == (ns.charAt(diff_pos) - '0')) continue;
                    if (num_len == ns.length() && d > (ns.charAt(diff_pos) - '0')) continue;
                    
                    StringBuilder new_prefix = new StringBuilder(cur_prefix).append((char)('0' + d));
                    long new_val = cur_val * 10 + d;
                    
                    long base_count = 0;
                    StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < new_prefix.length(); ++i) {
                        char start_digit = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char c = start_digit; c < new_prefix.charAt(i); ++c) {
                            base_count += count_numbers_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + c, n, ns);
                        }
                        tmp.append(new_prefix.charAt(i));
                    }
                    base_count += new_prefix.length() - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> coeffs = new ArrayList<>();
                    tmp = new StringBuilder(new_prefix);
                    for (int i = new_prefix.length(); i < num_len; ++i) {
                        int cnt = (int)(count_numbers_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + '0', n, ns) % MOD);
                        coeffs.add(cnt);
                        tmp.append('0');
                    }
                    
                    base_count += 1;
                    base_count -= new_val * pow10[num_len - new_prefix.length()];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < coeffs.size(); ++i) {
                        coeffs.set(coeffs.size() - 1 - i, (coeffs.get(coeffs.size() - 1 - i) - (int)(pow10[i] % MOD)) % MOD);
                    }
                    
                    int b = (int)(base_count % MOD);
                    if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < coeffs.size(); ++i) {
                        int c = coeffs.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (c < 0) c += MOD;
                        coeffs.set(i, c);
                    }
                    
                    meet_in_middle(coeffs, b, ans);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Handle exact prefixes
        StringBuilder prefix = new StringBuilder();
        long val = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            prefix.append(ns.charAt(len-1));
            val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long cnt = 1;
            StringBuilder tmp = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < prefix.length(); ++i) {
                char start_digit = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char c = start_digit; c < prefix.charAt(i); ++c) {
                    cnt += count_numbers_with_prefix(tmp.toString() + c, n, ns);
                }
                tmp.append(prefix.charAt(i));
            }
            cnt += prefix.length() - 1;
            cnt -= val;
            cnt %= MOD;
            if (cnt < 0) cnt += MOD;
            
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(cnt));
        }
        
        ans[0] = ans[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007));
        pw.println(to_string(ans[0]));
        pw.close();
    }
}
